items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1960-11-30
items.q: Did Orr make the F? No, me. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. No, Orr didn't have too high a range on his horn

ctx.x: I got some records, old records with Orr used to make F on.

I think it was the record Shine, I thought. Made F on the floor. Did Orr make the F? No, me. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. No, Orr didn't have too high a range on his horn when he was... Big broad sound, you know. What's on the other side?
The Sheik. Oh, yeah. Where you get a chance to hear Cattrall and whoever at home. What's on the other side? The Sheik. Oh, yeah.
